# Tidepool — generated by an agent, unedited

This round was produced by **Claude Code 2.1 with canvas-ui installed**, in a headless run with no human input. Nothing the agent wrote in `r1/` (cards, tokens, HTML, content) was edited afterwards. Only the generated `canvas.html` and `shots/` are rebuilt by the current tools so the demo uses the latest canvas.

- Input: [brief.md](brief.md), a dated `index.html` (Arial, a blue gradient, emoji cards), and this prompt:

  > Redesign our homepage (index.html) for Tidepool, see brief.md. Explore three directions and build them as first screens on the comparison canvas so I can compare. I'm away, so don't wait for me: build the canvas round, pick the one you'd go with, and stop there (don't build the full page).

- Output: three direction cards, tokens, three 390×844 first screens, the canvas, shots, and [design-brief.md](design-brief.md) with its pick (A, *Tide Table*) and reasoning.
- Run: 38 turns, about 3 minutes. It chose mobile because the brief says tourists book on phones, and the lint was clean on the final shots.
